log.body:
Skip to content
Round Again
Repair co-op
Membership
Notification preferences

A co-op for the things worth keeping

Good things
deserve another
chapter.

A favourite jumper. A wobbly chair. A kettle with a story.
Keep them going, with a little help from your neighbours.

Become a member
£8 per month
A little each month. A lot, together.
Still plenty of life in it.

More mending. Less ending.

✳

Mend what you have. Learn what you can. Share what you know.

✳
Good for your things.
Even better, together.

Your membership keeps shared tools, shared skills
and patient repair within reach.

Make room for repair.

A monthly repair evening with shared tools.

Bring something that needs a little attention. Find the tools, space and company to give it another go.

Pass a good skill on.

Skill swaps led by fellow members.

A stitch, a fix, a trick you didn’t know. Learn from your neighbours and share what comes naturally.

Build it together.

A say in which tools and projects we support.

This is your co-op, too. Help decide what we add to the toolbox and what we take on next.

There’s a place for you at the workbench.

Let’s give things
another go.

You don’t need to be handy. Just curious.
Join the Round Again member list.

£8 per month
For shared tools, shared skills and a say.

Your name
Email address
Join the demo member list

Just a little trial run. This is a prototype: your details stay in this browser. No payment, email or external submission.

A little care. A lot more life.
